description:
Session 01a07292 exposed queued-branch push rejection (#2055/#2056), unpublished fixes, wrong-PR operations, and #2076 merging before its corrections. Extend Makefile pr-open/pr-ready and the existing hold/revocation path. Prior art: Makefile:1376-1454, _project/scripts/auto_merge_soundness_paths.py, tests/unit/workflows/test_auto_merge_partial_stack_race.py, scripts/worktree_lifecycle_metadata.py. A local safety preflight or an empty thread scan is not completed review. Coordinate all writers through explicit repo/PR/node-id/head/worktree identity; do not infer the PR from a reused branch alone.

FEATURE-BATCH EXTENSION: the ready transaction also binds batch ID/version, declared member set, owner generation and current integration head. Require every member integrated with valid attribution, no active/pending authorized member writer, all final-tree verifications and current review dispositions. A late member, changed batch membership, conflict resolution or edit to prior member content invalidates readiness and affected receipts. Use the canonical prepared contract and existing helper, not a second readiness implementation. Standard non-batch PRs retain their current interface.

anti_patterns.dont: Treat a snapshot, a queued review, a skipped hook or an unbound passing check as completion
anti_patterns.instead: Bind actual evidence to the relevant PR/head/input and retain an explicit owned next action
anti_patterns.why: The observed session repeatedly lost asynchronous work or overstated evidence

preserves.behavior: KEEP_IDLE and SHADOW_ONLY remain in force for skip/shard/demotion/reduced-refresh proposals; this plan does not activate them.
Keep GitHub native merge queue as the only merger; no privileged steward, bypass actor, direct protected-branch push, or new bot credential.
Preserve required PR, merge_group, and post-merge coverage, soundness maintainer review, explicit user authority, and durable hold labels.

prior_art.concept: Existing implementation or governing evidence to extend without a parallel authority
Existing implementation or governing evidence to extend without a parallel authority

verifications.description: Revision/readiness transitions prevent wrong-head and late-fix merges
verifications.expected: exit 0; behavioral negative controls fail on the prior implementation

work_units.notes: Define explicit start-revision and ready transitions using one cohesive helper behind existing Make targets. Bind repo, PR node/number, expected head, branch and worktree; reconcile lifecycle metadata and live GitHub state. Preserve the initial snapshot and deny ambiguous or foreign ownership.
work_units.summary: Define explicit PR, head, worktree and owner identity for revision and readiness

work_units.notes: Before the first edit, disable previous auto-merge/dequeue or apply an effective existing draft/hold mechanism, verify the hold remotely, then permit writes. If merge wins the race, stop modifying that closed PR and preserve commits for a correctly identified follow-up. Never remove a user/maintainer hold.
work_units.summary: Withdraw and verify prior readiness before any revision begins

work_units.notes: Ready requires local/remote head agreement, no unpublished authorized work, completed configured review on that exact head (including top-level findings), evidence for all dispositions, required checks and maintainer approvals. Queue through an expected-head compare-and-set API/CLI option; a head change invalidates readiness. A successful API request is not proof of merge.
work_units.summary: Require completed exact-head review and checks before expected-head enqueue

work_units.notes: Replay late-review-before-push, concurrent writer, head changing between check/enqueue, already-queued update, wrong worktree/PR, outage, durable user hold and soundness scenarios. Show an ordinary completed authorized PR can still proceed without repeated user confirmation; record residual races outside participating writers.
work_units.summary: Replay late review, concurrent writers, head races and protected holds
Bind feature-batch membership, integrated receipts and writer quiescence to readiness
